note: Share Everywhere adds themeable social share buttons driven by one config object share_everywhere.settings (form route share_everywhere.config_form at /admin/config/services/share_everywhere, permission 'administer share everywhere'). Buttons: facebook_like, facebook_share, twitter (renders via se-x/X), linkedin, messenger, viber, whatsapp, copy. Top-level keys include alignment (left/right), title, display_title, collapsible, location (content|links), include_css/include_js, content_types, view_modes, per_entity, enabled_entities. Buttons appear as the extra field 'share_everywhere' on node/commerce_product displays, via block share_everywhere_block, or Views field share_everywhere_field. No plugin types, no Drush. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real config keys read/written on the live site; scripts restore shipped defaults explicitly.

evals.prompt: I enabled the share_everywhere module on Drupal 11. Where do I configure it (route/path), what config object stores the settings, and which permission guards the form?
evals.expected_output: Configure at /admin/config/services/share_everywhere (route share_everywhere.config_form, permission 'administer share everywhere'). All settings live in the config object share_everywhere.settings.

evals.prompt: What are the ways share_everywhere can place its social share buttons on a Drupal site (block, field, etc.)?
evals.expected_output: Four ways: as the extra field 'share_everywhere' on node/commerce_product view displays (location=content), in the node links area (location=links), via the 'Share Everywhere Block' (share_everywhere_block), and via the Views field share_everywhere_field.

evals.prompt: Which social networks / share actions does the share_everywhere module provide buttons for?
evals.expected_output: Facebook like and Facebook share, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Messenger, Viber, WhatsApp, and Copy URL.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the share_everywhere buttons have been customised. Inspect the live configuration and tell me the current button alignment, and whether the WhatsApp button is enabled.
evals.expected_output: In share_everywhere.settings alignment is 'right' and buttons.whatsapp.enabled is 0 (WhatsApp disabled). Read via drush cget share_everywhere.settings.

evals.prompt: The share_everywhere buttons block on this site has a custom heading configured. Inspect the running configuration and state the exact title text set for Share Everywhere.
evals.expected_output: In share_everywhere.settings the title is 'SE_Custom_Heading' (display_title is on). Read via drush cget share_everywhere.settings title.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure share_everywhere to DISABLE the WhatsApp and Viber share buttons and set the button alignment to 'right'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In share_everywhere.settings set buttons.whatsapp.enabled=0, buttons.viber.enabled=0 and alignment='right' (via the settings form or drush/configFactory).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure share_everywhere to enable per-entity opt-in (so editors can toggle share buttons on individual nodes) and set the buttons heading title to exactly 'Share this'. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In share_everywhere.settings set per_entity=1 (truthy) and title='Share this'.
